params.body:
## Why

The VWE account and the Nederland Mobiel key are platform-wide: one account for every dealer. They
lived as `settings` rows with `dealer_id NULL`, typed in on the settings page, so every copy of the
database (demo, a migration, a dump in a mailbox) carried the live VWE password along with it. Per
dealer settings stay where they are; these four move to the environment.

Two smaller things came along because they sat in the same lines. `OwnStockService::setSoapRequest`
called `->value` on `first()` without a null check, so a missing settings row was a fatal on a
property of null instead of a lookup that returns nothing. And the VWE password is stored
*encrypted* (`Crypt::encryptString`, tied to the APP_KEY that saved it) while the env value is
plain, so a reader that decrypts both, or neither, is wrong half the time.

## What

- `App\Support\IntegrationCredentials` is the one place that resolves a platform credential:
  environment first (`config('variable.*')`), the settings row as fallback, decryption on the
  database path only, `null` when it is set nowhere. An undecryptable row is logged and reads as
  "not configured" rather than throwing on a dealer's screen. `origin()` says `env`, `database` or
  `missing` without ever touching the value.
- `config/variable.php` gains `vwe_username`, `vwe_password`, `vwe_message_type` next to the
  Nederland Mobiel key that was already there.
- Readers: `OwnStockService::setSoapRequest` and `executeNederlandMobielRequest` go through the new
  class (the null-check fatal is gone with it), and so does `stocklist:vwe-smoke`. A grep for
  `vwe_username|vwe_password|vwe_message_type|nederlandMobiel_api_key` leaves only the settings
  keys inside `IntegrationCredentials` itself and the translation labels.
- `stocklist:vwe-smoke` now reports per credential where it came from (`aanwezig (.env)` /
  `aanwezig (instellingentabel, terugval)` / `ONTBREEKT`), never the value. `stocklist:smoke`'s vwe
  line delegates to that command, so it follows without a change of its own.
- Settings screen: the panes `vwe` and `nederland-mobiel` are gone (blades deleted, the routes
  `settings.update.vwe_settings` and `settings.update.nederlandMobiel` and their controller actions
  with them). `SettingsTabs::LEGACY_NUMBERS` keeps 5 and 6 resolving, to the first pane, so an old
  `?tab=5` link is a page and not a 500.
- In their place a read-only pane **Koppelingen**. There was no natural pane to fold this into: the
  `support` pane is a mailto and nothing else, and hanging a status table under "support" would
  hide it from the one person who goes looking for it after a deploy. The new pane sits behind the
  same right that guarded the VWE pane (`vwe.index`, a rights-only placeholder route), so nobody
  gains or loses access: whoever could read the credentials can now read whether they are set. It
  lists every platform integration with "ingesteld" / "niet ingesteld" plus where the value comes
  from, and never a value.
- `CUTOVER.md` gets the table of keys to fill on production. `.env.example` gets the three VWE keys
  in the "Voertuigdata" section; the AutoConnect comment no longer claims the VWE account lives in
  the settings table, and the Nederland Mobiel comment says the row is only a fallback now.

Rebased on `main` after #255, which had just given the VWE pane a calmer layout: the `$vwePasswordSet`
flag that commit passed to the view and its two `vwe_password_set` / `vwe_password_unset` labels
are removed with the pane, so no settings page load runs that query for a form that is gone.

## Env keys to set

| Key | Where the old value came from | Who supplies it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VWE_USERNAME` | `settings` row `vwe_username` (dealer_id NULL) | Delta |
| `VWE_PASSWORD` | `settings` row `vwe_password`, encrypted with the old APP_KEY | Delta, or VWE if that key is gone |
| `VWE_MESSAGE_TYPE` | `settings` row `vwe_message_type` (usually `SB-DAT-VOERTUIG`) | Delta |
| `NEDERLAND_MOBIEL_API_KEY` | `settings` row `nederlandMobiel_api_key` | Delta (already read from the env before this PR) |

## Fallback behaviour

The app is in daily use, so nothing may break on a deploy that is one step ahead of the server
configuration. While an env is empty the settings row keeps working exactly as before, password
decryption included. Once the env is set the row is ignored and can be deleted. The only change a
dealer sees today is that the two forms are replaced by a status list: the values were platform
wide, so nobody but the platform ever had a reason to change them there.

## Checked

- `php artisan test --filter='SettingsTab|SmokeTest|CompiledViewsTest|IntegrationCredentials|Vwe|StylesheetSyntaxTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest'`
  against local MySQL `forge_test`: 140 tests, 887 assertions, green.
- New unit test `IntegrationCredentialsTest`: env wins over the row, the row is decrypted on
  fallback, an empty env value does not count as set, nothing anywhere is `null`, an undecryptable
  row logs and reads as missing, an unknown credential throws.
- `SettingsTabDeepLinkTest`: `?tab=5` and `?tab=6` still render (on the first pane), the two panes
  and their field names are nowhere on the page, and the Koppelingen pane reports "ingesteld"
  without printing the username or the password.
- `php artisan view:cache` plus `php -l` over every compiled view: clean.
params.title: VWE and NederlandMobiel credentials from the environment
